inscription: 19828 (stamped) | 797 (pencil, crop 2) | WELTE-MIGNON No. 797 Samson and Delilah, Finale, Act I, C. Saint-Saens, Played by [signature] (printed label, crop 3)
notes: No handwritten punch date found. Crop 1 carries a five-figure stamp in a serif type, set along the roll and evenly spaced with no separators. I read it as 1 9 8 2 8, the third and fifth figures being the same two-bowl form; 19628 is the other candidate, since a 6 and an 8 are hard to tell apart at this resolution. It looks to me like a production serial rather than a date: the type is a printer's face, the figures are machine-aligned, and there are no points between the groups. If it were meant as a date in the run-together style it would read 19.6.28 or 19.8.28, later than anything else read in the corpus so far, so I have not recorded it as one. Crop 2 has the roll number 797 in pencil, the two sevens crossed, agreeing with the printed leader label on crop 3.

Nothing written on any of the three crops. Crops 1 and 2 show the red paper where it meets the green cloth leader, crop 3 plain red paper with two perforations and one short dark mark about the size of a comma, which I take for a fibre or a speck of ink rather than writing.

Ink on ruled red paper, upper panel upright, two lines. The first gives the roll number 819, then the date in three groups separated by points, then the name Roth, all of it plain.
